scientific_claim: MonotonicCORAL guarantees strictly ordered cutpoint thresholds and valid ordinal probabilities
Config A baseline achieves 92.11% +- 0.94% accuracy, QWK=0.8712 +- 0.0249, MAE=0.1145 +- 0.0166 across 30 seeds
Exemplar single run (Seed 83) achieves 93.71% accuracy, 0.0889 MAE, 1.45% ECE
Species conditioning degrades ordinal grading (B vs A: mean difference -0.0360 QWK, t=-4.159, p_adj=0.000260)
Negative result confirmed on 100% group session-held-out split (B vs A: mean difference -0.0262 QWK, p_adj=0.01018)
Energy score detects unseen fruit species (81.99% overall AUROC, 92.49% on natural market images)
Mahalanobis detector collapses on natural market photography (AUROC 18.08% on real_quality vs 93.26% on studio)
Low pooled ECE (1.45% - 2.51%) is studio-dominated (85.5% fruits360); market bin calibration degrades to 10.29% - 18.42%
Selective prediction discarding least-confident 10% samples reduces MAE from 0.0889 to 0.0136 (84.7% error drop)
Full end-to-end pipeline achieves 31.2 FPS (BS=1) and 75.6 FPS (BS=32) in FP16 on RTX 3050; Head-only is >100,000 FPS
